name: Cyclist Nigel

intro.text: Coming off the moor on the B3212 at forty miles an hour, both hands on the bars. Both. Hands. Always.

win: That's the second time today I've lost control. The first was the hands. I'm not joking.
after: Something grabbed my handlebars by Postbridge once. I told myself it was the wind. The wind doesn't have knuckles.
